tests.description: Valid, invalid and boundary requests match the admitted CapabilityDefinition request schema.
Every terminal response carries exactly one admitted result or error shape.
Retries obey the declared idempotency scope and reject one key with a different request digest.

The Provider rejects any mismatch in Tenant, ClientApplication, Principal context, WorkOrder, ProviderResolution/Instance/Revision/Audience, Attempt, fencing, request, executable policy/budget/permissions or StagingGrant claims.
A stale fencing token cannot mutate state and attempt-local Event sequence remains contiguous and idempotent.
Oversized encoded request bodies are rejected with 413 before JSON parsing or Provider work begins.
Observed side effects do not exceed the CapabilityDefinition classification or approved policy.
Invoke, Status, Cancel and Event tokens are operation-bound; renewal sequence/predecessor lineage remains inside the original deadline and CommercialAuthorization.

Input ArtifactGrants bind the Capability Tenant, WorkOrder and InvocationAttempt; output uses an ArtifactStagingGrant plus shorter Artifact Gateway operation tokens, and the Provider cannot finalize ArtifactVersions.
Provider results contain bounded UsageObservation evidence; Platform assigns TechnicalUsageEntry identity, attribution, idempotency and recorded_at.
The Provider cannot exceed approved permissions, budget or gateway requirements.
